# `foxglove device-tokens`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](README.md)

```text
List and manage device tokens

Usage: foxglove device-tokens [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Create a device token
  delete  Delete a device token
  edit    Enable or disable a device token
  get     Get a device token
  list    List device tokens
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
